in_marathi.name: Ibha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Wish, Intention
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ibha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ibha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'ibh', which means 'to desire'. The name signifies one's innermost wish or intention. In Hindu mythology, Ibha is the name of a goddess who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees.
